claim_ceiling: S3a battery member interface and manifest only; no baseline-power or gap claim

global_prior.description: emits the empirical response-symbol frequencies from the observed prefix for every counterfactual action

majority.description: emits a point mass on the modal observed prefix symbol; empty prefix falls back to symbol 0

predict_all.description: emits a point mass on response symbol 31 for every counterfactual action

predict_none.description: emits a point mass on response symbol 0 for every counterfactual action

prediction_format.format: mapping from counterfactual action name to a full probability distribution over the frozen response alphabet
prediction_format.prediction_target: full response distribution over the 32-symbol alphabet for each counterfactual action

prefix_only_contract: inputs are past actions, observations, session boundaries, and step indices only; no future observations or simulator internals
